new_result.statement: If e3(BB^T)>=delta and H is any row set of size at most four, then for some r in {0,1,2,3} and T subset H of size r, det(B_TB_T^T) e_{3-r}(B_C P_T^perp B_C^T) >= delta/[4 binom(4,r)]. For the O0 delta=1/256 this gives the explicit R0/R1/R2/R3 packets 1/1024, 1/4096, 1/6144, 1/4096 respectively.
new_result.method: partition raw third-compound Gram principal-minor mass by heavy-overlap cardinality and exact heavy pattern; apply the Gram Schur determinant identity and re-sum by elementary symmetric polynomials

partner_applied.application: R3 packet gives a three-physical-row cross block with determinant Gram at least 1/4096, hence density at most 12 sqrt(e) < 19.785 after conditioning outside the two active original-coordinate banks.
